name: Texas

workSearch.rule: At least 3 work search contacts per week (your local workforce board may set a different number).

howToFile: Apply online at ui.texasworkforce.org or call the TWC Tele-Center.
Have your last employer's name, address and your dates of work ready.
Register in WorkInTexas.com within 3 business days unless exempt.
Request payment every two weeks and log your work search contacts for each week.
